paite: Heutute aw, nou leng van ah heutupa na neih uh thei in, na sikhate uh tung ah adik atang leh akilawm hih un.
heading: Heutute Leh Pathian
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

paite: Thum gige unla, kipahthu gen kawm in kiveng gige un.
heading: Kithuhilhnate
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

paite: Khrist thuguk gen ding a Pathian in thu a dia kong a hon honsak theihna ding in kou leng hon thumsak un, huai thu ziak a hen a om ka hi.
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

paite: Ka gen ding bangtak a ka genkhiak theihna ding in.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

paite: Hun na neih sung un atam theipen sem zel unla, polam mite lak ah piltak in om un.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

paite: Michih bangchibang a dawn ding hiam chih na theihna ding un na paukam suak uh chisoh, hehpihna hi gige hen.
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

paite: Toupa a unau ngaihtak, nasempa muanhuai, sikha hihpih Taikikas in ka tanchin tengteng nou ahon theisak ding hi.
heading: Chibai Bukna Nanungte
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

paite: Hiai ziak in, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh, na lungtang uh ahon khamuan theihna ding in amah na kiang uah ka hon sawl hi;
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

paite: Onesimas, unau muanhuai leh ngaihtak noumau lak a mi mah toh ahong ding uhi. Amau hiai lam a thil omdan tengteng ahon theisak ding uhi.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

paite: Aristarkhas, ka hentakpihpa'n nou chibai ahon buk hi. Barnabas tupa Marka in leng chibai ahon buk hi, amah tungtang thu ah thupiakte na mu uh; na kiang ua ahong paileh na kipahpih un;
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

paite: Jesu, Justas achih un chibai nou ahon buk hi. Huaite zeksummi ahi ua, huaite kia Pathian lalgam thu lam ah ka seppih leh ahon khamuante ahi uhi.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

paite: Epaphras noumau lak a mi mah, Khrist Jesu sikha in noute chibai ahon buk hi, ama'n Pathian deihlam photphot a piching leh gingta tinten a na dintheihna ding un, athumna ah noute a ding in akisuk gige hi.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

paite: Noumau a ding, Laodisia a omte a ding leh Hierapolis a omte a ding in phatuam angai mahmah chih ka theihpih hi.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

paite: Luka, daktor ngaihtak leh Dema in chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

paite: Laodisia khua a unau omte leh Nimphas leh a-inn a saptuamte chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

paite: Huan hiai laikhak na lak ua na sim nung un, Laodisia saptuamte lak ah leng simsak un; nou leng Laodisia a pen na na sim sam ding uhi.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

paite: Huan Arkippas kiang ah, "Nasepna Toupa a i muh pen tangtun ding in pilvang in," na chi un.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

paite: Kei Paul in keimah khut ngei a hiai chibai bukna ka hon gelh ahi. Ka kolbulhte theigige un. Hehpihna na kiang uah om hen, Amen.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
